title: Reality of Harshad Mehta SCAM
description:

The scandalous rise and fall of India's first "Big Bull" - Harshad Mehta orchestrated the 1992 securities scam, manipulating the Bombay Stock Exchange through bank receipt fraud worth over ₹4,000 crore. His journey from a middle-class broker to stock market kingpin revolutionized Indian trading before ending in notorious disgrace.

Source - "The Scam" by Debashis Basu and Sucheta Dalal
